m: Oven to 220°C. Halve the potatoes and roast with a little oil and salt for 15 minutes.
Add the zucchini in chunks, the beans and tomatoes, crushed garlic, oregano, salt and a little oil. Toss and roast 5 minutes.
Nestle the salmon in among the veg, season, and lay lemon slices on top.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon just flakes.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon and scatter parsley.
l: Salmon and veg together. Eat cold with a squeeze of lemon, or warm gently.
